_comment: THE PERSONA-COPY REGISTRY. Declarative list of every fleet repo whose CLAUDE.md is known to carry its own hand-copied One-Brain persona block (see dream-team/ONE-BRAIN-PERSONA.md for the canonical text those copies are diffed against). WHY IT EXISTS: the persona block cannot safely be de-duplicated into a short pointer (each repo's Claude Code session reads its own CLAUDE.md directly at session start; a pointer only works if every session reliably follows it, which is not guaranteed), so 11+ repos each keep a full, independently-editable copy on purpose. That is a genuine drift surface: a copy can be hand-edited, partially updated, or left behind when the fleet-wide wording changes, with nothing to notice. Config-driven and hand-curated on purpose (mirrors skills/continuity-canary/expected-docs.json's convention exactly) because this list changes rarely and deliberately -- there is no auto-discovery/auto-grep at runtime, so adding a new app repo's CLAUDE.md to the fleet means adding it here too, the same one-time step continuity-canary's own registry requires. Session sandboxes across the fleet consistently mount each repo at a fixed /home/user/<repo> path (see every app CLAUDE.md's own session-start conventions), so absolute paths here are stable, the same assumption setup/add-repo.sh and octools-sync.sh already make. Established 2026-07-22 by grepping every /home/user/*/CLAUDE.md for the literal opening sentence 'You are the OTCHealth AI Operating System'; re-run that grep periodically to catch a NEW repo adopting the block without yet being registered here (persona-drift-canary itself only watches repos already listed, by design, exactly like continuity-canary only watches docs already listed).

repos.name: otchealth-claude-tools
repos.note: This repo's own root CLAUDE.md is also the source dream-team/ONE-BRAIN-PERSONA.md's canonical block was copied from; it should therefore always MATCH by construction unless one of the two later drifts from the other.

repos.name: otchealth-cto
repos.note: Known-drifted as of the 2026-07-22 baseline run: this copy is hand-customized (names brain_search/mcp.otchealth.app explicitly, names CLO/clo-personal/CFO in its ring-isolation sentence, appends a Canonical-spec citation sentence) rather than byte-identical to the other 10 repos. Left in the registry deliberately so the canary keeps reporting it, not removed to make the run look clean.
